title: SLA | A contract in one department can use a support plan from another department: TAVI now vs Zoho live
label: SAME AS ZOHO EXCEPT DEPARTMENT-ONLY CHANGE
date: TAVI 17 Nov 2026 (lane BS + ZC re-confirm) · Zoho live 17 Nov 2026 12:55-13:45Z
env: TAVI staging-desk (NDC-Staging, Dept A = QA RT19 SLA Dept, Dept B = QA RT19 SLA Dept B, BS plans 2841 A/B w2pv, contract QA RT20 ZC Contract 2841 dept only) · Zoho Desk techegysolutions (admin; TechEgySolutions + Tech; QA RT20 ZC Plan A / B / B2, contract QA RT20 ZC C1; all deleted and purged)

panels.caption: TAVI New Contract, Department = QA RT19 SLA Dept: plan list has only that department's plans

Zoho Add Contract (TechEgySolutions) > Select Support Plan: only the department's own plan

rows: Create a contract with another department's plan (form list + API)
Picker lists only the department's plans; API 422 "Invalid SupportPlan ID", nothing created
Form lists only the chosen department's plans; API 422 SUPPORT_PLAN_OTHER_DEPARTMENT x3, nothing created
SAME
Change the plan to another department's plan
API 422 "Invalid SupportPlan ID", plan kept; in the UI the plan is locked on an active contract
Record PATCH 422, panel attach 409, plan kept (TAVI still lets you switch to an own-department plan: extra, not a bug)
SAME
Department changed in the form after a plan was picked

Add form has no Department field (the header department is used; switching it asks to leave the page). Edit form: the plan is cleared, picker shows only the new department's plans, Save blocked "Support Plan cannot be blank"
Red "This plan belongs to another department..." under the field, list switches to the new department, Save refused 422
SAME
Contract without department
API 422 /departmentId missing (and a plan is mandatory: no plan -> 422)
422 "Department is required."
SAME
Change ONLY the department of a contract that has a plan
Refused: UI lock "You cannot update a Contract's department."; API 422 "Invalid SupportPlan ID" (3 tries); contract unchanged
200: contract becomes Dept B and keeps Dept A's plan + SLA (coverage still Dept A plan/policy); no message. UI detail page has no department edit control - API path only
DIFFERS
Move to another department together with a matching plan
Never in place: API 422 "DepartmentId cannot be updated" (x2); UI Save creates a NEW contract in the new department, the original stays as it was
200: the same contract moves to Dept B with Dept B's plan (consistent; TAVI extra, not a bug)
